relay.health.live.role: session status label (app bar status dot)
relay.health.live.tone: One short state word, sentence case, no trailing period.
relay.health.live.note: Accessible name and sheet title for the GREEN status dot in a conversation's header: the session's process is running on the user's computer, its heartbeat is fresh and the phone's link to it is up. Sibling states reuse existing keys: relay.chrome.session.subtitle.not_answering (yellow) and relay.chrome.session.subtitle.ended (grey); keep the same register as those two.

relay.health.live_detail.tone: Plain, reassuring statement; sentence case; no trailing period (matches relay.chrome.session.ended_hint).
relay.health.live_detail.note: Body of the sheet that opens when the reader taps the green status dot. 'Your computer' is the machine running the agent session (not the phone). 'Right away' means a message is delivered to the running session now, not queued for a restart; it may still wait for the agent's current step to finish, so do not promise an instant reply.

relay.health.reconnecting.role: session status label (app bar status dot)
relay.health.reconnecting.tone: One short state word, sentence case, no trailing period, no ellipsis.
relay.health.reconnecting.note: Owned relay SPA chrome for the session header's status dot and the sheet it opens (docs/design/mobile-relay-guidelines.md, Composer and startup). Title of the sheet and tooltip of the YELLOW status dot when the PHONE's own connection is down (the computer may be fine). Same register as relay.health.live and relay.chrome.session.subtitle.not_answering / .ended, which name the other states.

relay.health.reconnecting_detail.tone: Plain, calm statement of fact; sentence case.
relay.health.reconnecting_detail.note: Owned relay SPA chrome for the session header's status dot and the sheet it opens (docs/design/mobile-relay-guidelines.md, Composer and startup). Body of the sheet for the reconnecting state. 'This phone' is the device showing the screen; 'your computer' is the machine running the agent session. The point to keep: it is the phone's connection that is down, the session itself may still be running, and the phone keeps trying to reconnect on its own. 'A send may fail' is deliberate — do not promise that messages wait or are queued.

relay.health.dropped_detail.tone: Plain statement of fact; sentence case; no blame.
relay.health.dropped_detail.note: Owned relay SPA chrome for the session header's status dot and the sheet it opens (docs/design/mobile-relay-guidelines.md, Composer and startup). Body of the sheet for the YELLOW 'Not answering' state when the computer cannot reach the session (the phone itself is online). 'Your computer' is the machine running the session, and the computer keeps trying to reach it by itself. True behaviour to keep: a message sent now fails immediately (it does NOT wait or queue), and the typed text is put back in the message box — the message field at the bottom of the screen.

relay.health.quiet_detail.tone: Plain statement of fact; sentence case; honest about uncertainty.
relay.health.quiet_detail.note: Owned relay SPA chrome for the session header's status dot and the sheet it opens (docs/design/mobile-relay-guidelines.md, Composer and startup). Body of the sheet for the YELLOW 'Not answering' state when the session is reachable but has gone quiet (no heartbeat and no updates for a while). True behaviour to keep: a send can report a failure yet still be delivered once the session catches up; retrying is safe, because the same message is not delivered twice. Do not promise queueing or delivery.

relay.health.ended_detail.note: Owned relay SPA chrome for the session header's status dot and the sheet it opens (docs/design/mobile-relay-guidelines.md, Composer and startup). Body of the sheet for the GREY 'Ended' state, shown under the title 'Ended' and above the Resume button — so it must add information, not repeat 'ended'. 'Resume' names that button: use the same word as relay.chrome.session.resume. 'Home folder' is the user's home directory on the computer: the session comes back there, not in its original project folder.

relay.health.ended_send_failed.tone: Plain, actionable; no blame; sentence case.
relay.health.ended_send_failed.note: Owned relay SPA chrome for the session header's status dot and the sheet it opens (docs/design/mobile-relay-guidelines.md, Composer and startup). Shown in the message box's error area when sending to an ENDED session failed to reopen it. 'Try again' means sending again. “Ended” (keep the quotation marks, using the locale's own quotation marks) is the status word shown under the conversation title at the top of the screen; tapping it opens a sheet whose button is Resume. Use the same words as relay.chrome.session.subtitle.ended and relay.chrome.session.resume.
